title: Component pullback coefficient and scalar comparison squares
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and T a w-contractible affine scheme [sk-def-pe-wlocal]. For the fixed relative test inverse image [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model], assume continuity, braidedness and preservation of finite limits and colimits. Then there is a ring-object coefficient isomorphism alpha and a monoidal factorization beta from restriction to pi_0(T) followed by component inverse image to the actual point inverse image, with alpha induced by beta at Lambda. The corresponding componentComparisons hold: triangulated strong symmetric component pullback preserves the unit, induces the lisse equivalence, and carries the actual section-ring realization and both point-scalar realizations to one another by the displayed natural isomorphisms. The section-ring isomorphism in componentComparisons commutes with point scalars, with their images computed by the explicit monoidal point-inverse-image section affineScalarSection [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model].

proof.text: Lift the monoidal point factorization to monoid objects using mapMonCompIso and mapMonNatIso; its underlying hom is beta at Lambda, giving alpha with the required equality.
Use the normalized section-ring realization comparisons and derived symmetry. Exact mapDerivedCategory is triangulated; its monoidal unit isomorphism gives unit preservation.

The proved lisse assembly conjugates perfect scalar transport by the two contractible evaluation equivalences. The proved final scalar assembly composes point realization and derived scalar comparisons. Combine these with the preceding comparisons to obtain every conjunct.
